messages:
Elaine (Docs): Hey team — I'm opening a PR to combine a bunch of tiny rate/quota examples into a short 'operator playbook'. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822
Mike (Eng-Billing): saw it. quick ask: can we include a tiny decision matrix for when to use burst credits vs tiered allowances? that's what customers keep asking.
Sam (Pricing): +1. Also we should clarify how monthly vs rolling-window quotas are billed in the examples — I hit confusion in the FAQ.
Rachel (Analytics): I can add one chart for expected token consumption patterns by tier (p50/p95) — will that help the playbook be more prescriptive?
Elaine (Docs): yes please. main goals: (1) concise examples developers can copy into SDK snippets, (2) a short section on billing implications, (3) explicit guidance for dashboards/alerts. Keep it <800 words.
Mike (Eng-Billing): FYI there are two edge cases I want to call out: when a request uses a pinned dedicated model (no quota) vs hosted fallback (metered). We need a snippet showing headers to force the hosted path and how quotas apply.
Sam (Pricing): here's a suggested SDK example for the header pattern — feel free to reword.
Sam (Pricing): ```python
# force hosted fallback path (affects billing)
client.request("/v1/generate", headers={"x-rw-routing":"hosted"}, body={"model":"gpt-lite-3"})
```
Elaine (Docs): perfect — I'll paste that in the playbook under "billing-aware routing". Can someone confirm the exact header name? Mike?
Mike (Eng-Billing): header is `x-rw-routing: hosted` (Sam's example matches). Also add a note: "Requests routed to hosted variants count against hosted quotas and tiered pricing".
Rachel (Analytics): For the dashboard section, add a snippet for the Prometheus/Grafana panel query we recommend. Example: `sum(rate(rw_tokens_total[5m])) by (tier)` — that maps to per-tier ingress.
Elaine (Docs): nice. Add a short note about spike smoothing / alert thresholds (p95 over 10m).
Sam (Pricing): One more wording nit — change "burst credits" to "temporary burst allowance" in the customer-facing examples. Less jargon-y.
Elaine (Docs): agreed. I'll make that substitution across the PR.
docs-bot: lint check passed for docs PR #4822 — small link-warning: external link missing https scheme in one example (docs).
Elaine (Docs): thanks bot — found it. fixing the broken link to billing playbook cross-ref.
deploy-bot: staging preview built: https://staging.docs.redwood/inference/rateplaybook/4822 — preview will expire in 48h.
Mike (Eng-Billing): quick question for accuracy: when a customer has tiered monthly allowance + burst, do we deduct from allowance first then burst, or burst first? Sam?
Sam (Pricing): allowance first, burst is used when allowance exhausted; I'll add a line and a tiny table to the playbook showing order of operations.
Rachel (Analytics): I'll attach a sample dashboard panel JSON for the Grafana panel so docs can paste it in.
Elaine (Docs): brilliant. timeline: I'll update PR today, Sam/Rachel/Mike can LGTM + merge after signoff. If anyone wants to pair on the small table text, ping me.
Mike (Eng-Billing): will review tonight. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Pricing): will review as well. thanks Elaine.
Rachel (Analytics): will drop the panel JSON in a follow-up comment on the PR.
Elaine (Docs): great — closing the loop here. If we get many customer questions after this lands, I'll add a short FAQ with the three most common confusions. :memo:
